customer_jane: Hey team — our service key just started returning 403 on /v1/generate. Embeddings and rerank calls still work.
customer_jane: Here's the curl we run: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX' -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-1\", \"input\":\"hello\"}'`
customer_jane: Response: `{\"error\":{\"message\":\"insufficient_scope: missing 'generate' on token\", \"code\":403, \"trace_id\":\"tr_7b2c9\"}}`
alex.s: Thanks for the report — can you DM me the org_id and the key id? Also when did you provision/rotate this key last?
customer_jane: Sent via DM. We rotated yesterday after SSO onboarding.
alex.s: Looks like the key metadata shows scopes: ["embeddings","rerank"], no "generate". Did you use the SCIM/provisioner flow or the org console?
maria.i: FYI we had a fix last week on the provisioner that changed CSV parsing for scopes. There was a case where semicolon-delimited scopes got parsed incorrectly and some tokens were dropped silently.
reena: Can you paste the raw provisioning log entry? If it went through the new provisioner, I can check conversion.
customer_jane: Here is the provisioning payload (redacted): `scopes: "embeddings,rerank,generate"` and the provisioner response shows `accepted: true`
provisioner-bot: Provisioner log 2026-03-15T18:12:04Z - received scopes field: "embeddings; rerank; generate" - normalized to: ["embeddings","rerank"] - reason: delimiter mismatch (semicolons treated as whitespace for legacy flow)
alex.s: Ah — provisioner normalized `;` into separators but our parser only treats commas as authoritative; trailing token got dropped because of extra space. That matches the missing "generate" scope.
reena: Short-term fix: create a new API key via the Console or Admin API with explicit scopes: `generate,embeddings,rerank`. Long-term: infra will patch parser to accept both `,` and `;` and preserve tokens.
maria.i: I've filed infra ticket INF-4321 and rolled a hotfix branch. ETA for patch to prod is ~4h.
reena: Workaround CLI/API to grant generate scope: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys/patch -H 'Authorization: Bearer ADMIN_SK' -d '{"key_id":"<id>","add_scopes":["generate"]}'` — requires org-admin creds.
customer_jane: Thanks — I ran the patch command and regenerate test works now. Generation returned 200 and trace_id `tr_7b2c9` — same trace id as before.
alex.s: Great. I'll keep this thread open until hotfix lands and we verify new provisioning doesn't drop tokens.
support-bot: Ticket SC-2026-118 created, assigned to infra.
reena: Post-patch we should add an automated test in the provisioning e2e to assert that scopes parse both `,` and `;` and that all tokens survive trimming.
maria.i: Agreed. I'll add the test. Thanks for quick triage everyone :thumbsup:
__notes: single-string Slack thread; messages prefixed by sender; short, realistic Slack tone; includes bot lines, commands, logs, and a temporary workaround.
